verdicts.reason: S035 says the Pier 4 Bag-Drop Unit sends an Oversize Exception Ticket, and S141's 'the exception ticket' used by the Image Resolution Desk for an oversize bag unambiguously refers to that ticket.
S011 states that the Flight Data Gateway sends the Flight Cutoff Advisory, and S113 states that the Baggage Control System receives the Flight Cutoff Advisory.
S061 says the South Gate Scanner produces a Manual Rescan Receipt, and S159's 'the rescan receipt' used by the Image Resolution Desk clearly denotes that receipt.
S085 states that the Primary Crossbelt Sorter sends a Chute Occupancy Note, and S184 says the Baggage Operations Supervisor uses 'the occupancy note.'
S038 states that the Transfer Bag Feeder sends a Late Transfer Bag Card, and S143 says the Bag Reconciliation Station uses the Late Transfer Bag Card.
S120 says the Explosives Response Team produces the Custody Seal Log, and S213 says the Security Duty Manager uses 'the seal log.'
S013 states that the Concourse Zone Controller produces the Recovery Route Card, and S185 says the Maintenance Technician consults the Recovery Route Card.
S074 says the Bag Tag Printer produces a Calibration Witness Tag, and S176's 'the witness tag' used by the Maintenance Technician refers to that item.
S101 states that the Bag Reconciliation Station sends a Bag Match Query, and S219 says the Airline Ramp Coordinator uses the Bag Match Query.
S052 says the Airline Ramp Coordinator sends a Carousel Release Slip, and S148 says the Carousel 7 Make-Up Unit receives the Carousel Release Slip.
S010 establishes Mosslight as the alias for the Concourse Zone Controller, and the document does not use Mosslight for any other entity.
S008 establishes Velvet as the alias for the Baggage Control System, and the document does not use Velvet for anything else.
S050 establishes Juniper as the local name for the Primary Crossbelt Sorter, and S166 uses Juniper consistently with that entity.
S047 establishes Kestrel as the local name for the North Gate Scanner, and S167 uses Kestrel consistently with that entity.
S068 establishes Pebble as a name for the Explosives Response Team in local radio traffic, and S186 uses Pebble consistently with that entity.
S075 establishes Orchard as the local name for the Carousel 7 Make-Up Unit, and S216 uses Orchard consistently with that entity.
S080 establishes Lantern as the operational alias for the Flight Data Gateway, and S190 uses Lantern consistently with that entity.
S091 establishes Tern as the operational alias for the Baggage Operations Supervisor, and S241 uses Tern consistently with that entity.
S168 explicitly names the North Gate Scanner, not the South Gate Scanner, as recording the tag read and image data.
S195 explicitly names the East Make-Up Conveyor, not the West Make-Up Conveyor, as running only after the stated guard and capacity conditions are met.
